plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve lactate threshold and running speed.
Incorporates a long run to build endurance and trail-specific durability.
Provides a more varied stimulus, promoting more well-rounded development.
plan_b_advantages: Higher volume of easy running may be beneficial for some athletes.
The focus on trail running throughout the week may be more specific to the athlete's goals.
reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans incorporate rest days and easy runs, Plan A includes a tempo run and a long run, which are crucial for developing speed and endurance respectively. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on easy runs, which, while important for building a base, won't sufficiently challenge the athlete to improve their speed. The inclusion of a tempo run in Plan A allows for development of lactate threshold, a key factor in trail running performance.
